name: Final newline
description: Requires non-empty files to end with exactly one newline.
definition: Requires, as a `[warning]`, every non-empty file to end with exactly one newline. Extra blank lines after the last content line are also flagged. This rule is enabled only by the strict preset. Automatically fixable: the fix appends a newline that matches the file's existing line endings (`\n` or `\r\n`) and collapses extra trailing newlines to one.
